newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to seek consultancy over sewage selloffs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to seek consultancy over sewage selloffs.

text.p: The Brazilian government has authorized the National Development Bank (BNDES) to hire consultants to advise on the privatization of water and sewage companies, Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said.

The consultants hired by the BNDES would be asked to draw up proposals for how Brazil's state and municipally owned water and sewage companies might be sold off, Kandir said after a meeting of the National Privatization Council.

The minister said the companies represetnted a "new front" for Brazil's privatization program, which began with steel, petrochemical and fertilizer firms and has recently been expanded to include power and telecommunications companies.
There was no estimate as yet for the value of Brazil's water and sewage companies, Kandir said.
